verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs describe a client-side integration across web, iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter. The server calls /sessions or the /paymentMethods, /payments, and /payments/details flow, and Adyen sends payment data to your client-side application. The docs also cover styling customization and localization of the payment form, plus client-key authentication for allowed origins, which together imply an embedded checkout. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the named embeddable UI components (e.g., Drop-in/Components) and their customization depth, an explicit contrast with a hosted/redirect checkout, and independent hands-on corroboration of the embedded experience.
